definitions.explanation: Expresses that despite any amount of effort or quantity, the result remains the same.

examples.japanese: いくら⟦{説明|せつめい}して→説明する：01449_setsumei⟧も⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how much I explain, they don't understand.

examples.japanese: いくら⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧も⟦{太|ふと}らない→太る：01190_futoru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how much I eat, I don't gain weight.

examples.japanese: いくら⟦{待|ま}って→待つ：00469_matsu⟧も⟦{来|こ}なかった→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how long I waited, they didn't come.

examples.japanese: いくら⟦{頑張|がんば}って→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧も⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{受|う}からない→受かる：noentry⟧。
examples.english: No matter how hard I try, I can't pass the exam.

examples.japanese: いくら⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧あっても、⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧なければ⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: No matter how much money you have, it's meaningless if you don't have time.

notes:
いくら〜ても expresses futility or persistence.

PATTERN:
- いくら + Verb (て form) + も
- いくら + Adjective + ても

EXAMPLES:
- いくら{頑張|がんば}っても: no matter how hard I try
- いくら{高|たか}くても: no matter how expensive

SIMILAR:
- どんなに〜ても: no matter how
- {何度|なんど}〜ても: no matter how many times
